name: Joshua Rotenberg
body: I'm applying for the Candidate Experience Specialist role on your onboarding team. A new hire's first impression of an employer is the onboarding process itself, and keeping that process clear, fast, and complete is the work I've done for most of my career.

At Wix I led onboarding teams of up to 30 people, helped hire and train new team members, and personally ran 25+ onboardings a month with about 25 in flight at once. Since then I've built automated reminder and follow-up workflows and kept auditable records across multiple systems, so nothing required gets missed and everyone waiting on a step knows where it stands. Earlier, I co-owned a state-licensed business where compliance documentation was a condition of staying open.
Healthcare matters to me personally, from years of navigating the system as a patient. I'd welcome a conversation about how I can support your hiring managers and new hires.
